# Execution environment and infrastructure `INF`

[As built](../README.md) › Execution environment and infrastructure

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Provides the sealed, configured environments agents and gates run in: Docker container and compose management, egress proxying, credential handling, LLM call routing (llm.py, routes.py), guide delivery, and Gate 0 onboarding that proves an environment works before builds start. Configuration (config.py) is the single YAML-driven source of truth that the rest of this infrastructure reads.

20 files, 14,738 lines.
